# MailHub - Frequently Asked Questions
**Version:** 0.1.0

## General Questions
**What is MailHub?**
A professional email management and routing system designed for high-volume business communications.


**Who is this product for?**
This product is designed for users within the SaaS space.

## Billing & Access
**How is this product billed?**
Billing is managed via Stripe.

**How do I get access?**
Access is granted via the mailhub_access entitlement.

## Support
**What level of support do I receive?**
Your subscription includes Standard support.
